description: Independent Gaussian Z, Bernoulli expit(-0.5+Z) treatment, Y=2T+Z+0.5 epsilon; IID standard normal epsilon independent of Z and T.

oracle.method: stated DGP Y = 2T + Z + 0.5 epsilon: the population ATE is the coefficient 2
oracle.formula: ATE = 2 (coefficient of T; do(T) cuts Z -> T and E[Z] enters both arms); observed contrast = 2 + E[Z|T=1] - E[Z|T=0] with Z ~ N(0,1), P(T=1|Z) = expit(-0.5 + Z).
asserted_outputs: the point tolerance excludes the confounded observed contrast (the test asserts this on its sample)
context_only_outputs: replicates, seeds and coverage_acceptance (a calibration measurement, ignored in ordinary runs)
oracle.independence_basis: The generator reads the stated DGP, takes the ATE as the structural coefficient and computes the confounded contrast by Simpson quadrature over the standard normal; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the stated DGP.
oracle.historical_exposure: The original values were pinned in an earlier import whose harness was not retained; this reference was written during this review from the fixture formula and declared inputs, with the executing assertion read to establish which values it compares and no product implementation source consulted. Who first derived the pinned numbers is unrecorded.

point_conformance_note: Single fixed n=600 scenario, population ATE=2. Absolute tolerance 0.2 must also exclude the confounded unadjusted arm contrast. This is a point conformance check, not the 200-replicate bias/coverage measurement.
